Name: Valentine's Day Flower Crops
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[center][size=6][i][b]~ Valentine's Flowers ~
[/b]
[/i][/size][size=4]Second mod for this Valentine's week!~
[/size]
This mod includes six new crops
cute flowers to mach valentine's day and spring!

In the picture, their order is:
Super Rose
Soft Flower
Lovey Flower
Dovey Flower
Esteem Flower
Heart Flower

Hope you like them, and don't forget you're loved!

[u]I'm open to any suggestions!![/u]
[/center]

[size=5][i][center][b]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/center]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]


[i][size=4][u][b]By:  ~ Luna ~[/b][/u][/size][/i]
